reviews.matching_title: Mortgage rates remain elevated in the latest weekly survey; 30-year fixed near recent highs
reviews.summary: Freddie Mac's official Primary Mortgage Market Survey recorded a 7.40% 30-year fixed mortgage average on both October 8 and October 15, 2026. The October 15 release was the more recent published weekly observation; citing October 8 as the latest weekly release on October 16 was outdated.

sources_checked.finding: Freddie Mac's official 2026 weekly archive lists October 15, 2026: 30-year FRM 7.40%, 15-year FRM 6.71%; October 8, 2026: 30-year FRM 7.40%, 15-year FRM 6.73%.
Freddie Mac's October 15 release states that the 30-year fixed-rate mortgage averaged 7.40%, unchanged from October 8.

reviews.what_is_known: The stated 7.40% weekly average is supported by Freddie Mac's own data, subject to the PMMS sample methodology.
reviews.what_is_not_established: The 7.40% weekly average does not establish any particular lender's current quote or any intraday rate.
reviews.resolution_needed: Use the most recent available PMMS release and distinguish weekly observation date from story publication date.

reviews.matching_title: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh declines to signal a near-term rate move at IMF fireside chat; reiterates price stability priority
reviews.summary: The reported substance is corroborated: Warsh participated in the Oct. 16 IMF event, and independent AP and Reuters reporting agree that he emphasized price stability and declined to prejudge upcoming rate decisions. This is sufficient to corroborate the story's factual substance; exact wording matters only for direct quotations.

sources_checked.finding: IMF confirms the October 16 Bangkok fireside chat and participants; not a transcript.
Federal Reserve calendar lists Warsh's discussion at the IMF fireside chat.
Reuters separately reported Warsh did not signal the upcoming interest-rate choice and emphasized a data-based approach.
Associated Press independently reported that Warsh would not prejudge the upcoming meetings and emphasized price stability.

reviews.what_is_known: The scheduled official event took place and multiple independent reports agree on the substance of his comments.
reviews.what_is_not_established: The precise spoken language has not been independently compared with an official transcript or full recording.
reviews.resolution_needed: Retrieve the official audio/video or transcript for verbatim confirmation; distinguish substantive corroboration from primary-source quotation verification.
